stdout:
usage: compass-c [-h] [--version] [--db DB]
                 {start,get,review,brief,list,migrate,record,invalidate,revise,update-evidence,plan-experiment,experiments,experiment,observe-experiment,calculate,evaluate}
                 ...

COMPASS-C: local advisory decision records and bounded calculations

positional arguments:
  {start,get,review,brief,list,migrate,record,invalidate,revise,update-evidence,plan-experiment,experiments,experiment,observe-experiment,calculate,evaluate}
    start               create a task-owned decision notebook entry
    list                discover decisions and reconcile a lost start response
    migrate             explicitly upgrade an existing notebook schema
    revise              replace a note and invalidate dependent conclusions
    update-evidence     preview a sourced evidence batch; --apply explicitly
                        commits it
    plan-experiment     freeze a bounded experiment against the current
                        decision revision
    experiments         discover a decision's saved experiment plans
    experiment          resume a saved experiment and its next step
    observe-experiment  preview a sourced observation; --apply explicitly
                        records it
    evaluate            report frozen paired host evaluation results

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
  --db DB               workspace-owned SQLite notebook; not a security or
                        authorization boundary
